connectionFields.label: Imported task icon
connectionFields.helpText: Choose whether imported tasks keep the connector icon or switch to the linked project icon.

connectionFields.label: Urgent priority values
connectionFields.helpText: Priority field values that mean Urgent. Enter one number such as "1" or a range such as "1-3". Leave empty to give this level no values.

connectionFields.label: High priority values
connectionFields.helpText: Priority field values that mean High. Enter one number such as "1" or a range such as "1-3". Leave empty to give this level no values.

connectionFields.label: Medium priority values
connectionFields.helpText: Priority field values that mean Medium. Enter one number such as "1" or a range such as "1-3". Leave empty to give this level no values.

connectionFields.label: Low priority values
connectionFields.helpText: Priority field values that mean Low. Enter one number such as "1" or a range such as "1-3". Leave empty to give this level no values.

connectionFields.label: Auto sync to backlog
connectionFields.helpText: Import directly to backlog while the app is open.

github.description: Brings your GitHub pull requests into Ajour: the ones you wrote and the ones you were asked to review.

connectionFields.label: GitHub URL
connectionFields.helpText: Change it for GitHub Enterprise Server, for example https://github.acme.com.

connectionFields.label: Personal access token
connectionFields.helpText: Needs read and write access to pull requests and read access to the repositories, and read:org for team review requests.

connectionFields.label: Only these organizations or repositories
connectionFields.helpText: Comma-separated. An entry with a slash is a repository, otherwise an organization or user.

connectionFields.label: Include team review requests
connectionFields.helpText: Show pull requests where one of your teams was asked to review.

connectionFields.label: Sync automatically
connectionFields.helpText: Sync pull requests while the app is open.
